Subject: Re: ClearWave: Reserve & Eval Cutover playbook — GPU sizing and lead times

Thanks Olivia — draft playbook below (high level). I attached a spreadsheet with sizing assumptions and an acceptance checklist PDF. Please review and flag any constraints from procurement.

Summary (high-level MAP):
1) Eval window (2 weeks): benchmark on Redwood Hosted against your baseline (goal: match quality, validate p95 SLA under 20ms delta). Owner: ClearWave + Redwood Solutions. Target: 2026-07-27 to 2026-08-10.
2) Staging reserve (short tranche): reserve 8 A100-equivalent GPUs to validate staging throughput + KV cache behavior. Owner: Redwood Eng; hold date: 2026-08-17 (reserve request to capacity team).
3) Production commit (tranche): ramp to 32 A100-equivalent GPUs for production baseline supporting peak 1k rps with burst capacity. Commit date for procurement sign-off: 2026-08-31.
4) Private deployment lead time: VPC setup + networking + KMS keys typically 4–6 weeks from sign-off. Dedicated (hosted private pool) typical lead time: 3–4 weeks.
5) Acceptance gates: SOC2 evidence (if required), end-to-end ingest/egress checks, failover/fallback test, cost/runbook sign-off.

Immediate asks for ClearWave:
- Confirm eval dataset and two production model variants by 2026-07-20.
- Procurement confirm PO window constraints by 2026-07-23.

Action items assigned:
- Ben: Share sizing workbook and acceptance checklist (attached).
- Laura: Coordinate capacity reservation calendar with infra (cc’ing capacity ops).
- Vivek: Validate VPC onboarding runbook and KMS integration steps.

Best,
Ben
Attachment: clearwave_map_v1.xlsx, acceptance-checklist.pdf

Subject: Re: ClearWave: Reserve & Eval Cutover playbook — GPU sizing and lead times

Raj — quick numbers from infra and finance ops (estimates):
- Estimated monthly run-rate @ 32 A100-eq (on Dedicated pricing sheet): $85k/mo (base reserved), burst usage billed at $0.45/GB of GPU memory-minute (approx model-dependent).
- Staging tranche (8 GPUs) monthly equivalent: $22k/mo.
- Worst-case overage example: 10% sustained burst for 72 hours on peak day -> incremental ~$4.5k.

Private (VPC) vs Dedicated lead time: +10–14 calendar days on average because of customer-side networking tasks (firewall rules, peering, KMS proof-of-possession) and our security review slot. We can overlap SOC2 evidence collection during that period to save time.

I'll update the spreadsheet with these numbers and add a two-tranche PO template and a 30-day rollback clause draft for your legal team to review.

Laura
Senior Deal Ops, Redwood Inference
